results.title: Arabian Gulf Cup begins Wednesday amid Middle East conflict
results.description: On the football field, much of the pressure will be on Saudi Arabia, which was eliminated in the group stage of the World Cup after failing to win any of its matches.

results.title: Formula One races to be shortened next season
results.description: PARIS: The governing body of motorsports (FIA) on Monday announced Formula One rules changes which included shortening Grand Prix races and putting the brakes on some proposed tinkering with gearboxes.

results.title: Jayden Daniels Injury Report: Commanders Await MRI Verdict As Quarterback Status Clouds Seahawks NFL Clash
results.description: Washington’s biggest storyline entering Week 3 remains unresolved as Jayden Daniels undergoes further evaluation, while multiple injury concerns continue to shape the Commanders’ preparations for Seattle.
